text: Yes, native forest was deforested on this property in 2022. The evidence shows a 0.6-hectare loss of tree cover in 2022, of which 0.5 hectares was confirmed as native forest by Uruguay’s official forest map (MGAP 2021). The loss area was fully mapped as forest in 2020 by the JRC, meeting the corroboration rule. While 0.2 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares (excluded from the event), the remaining 0.4 hectares of native forest loss still qualifies as a deforestation event under the 0.5-hectare minimum threshold.
